scope: Opt-in compact source-bound implementation output contract with immutable legacy readback and reviewed successor-sequence continuity.
riskAnalysis: Observed live Specialist response was incomplete at the enforced 4000 output-token limit; strict rejection was correct. New opt-in prompts and schema narrative bounds retain all semantic, source and patch fields without increasing limits or prescribing replacement text. Historical requests, policies, assignments and receipts must remain bit-identical and readable. Fresh reviewed source/config/task binding remains mandatory; no consumed grant or stopped sequence is reopened.

threatModel.assets: Source/patch integrity, immutable historical records, finite cumulative budget and attempts, reviewer attribution and Production isolation.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Untrusted model output to strict schema and patch guards; current policy admission to immutable historical readback; authenticated owner controller to restricted data-only worker.
threatModel.abuseCases: Legacy policy activation, stale release substitution, fabricated acceptance, missing criteria, truncated patches, cumulative allowance reset via successor sequence, source execution or publication.
threatModel.mitigations: Opt-in exact objective marker; legacy request bytes unchanged; strict completed-envelope and source/patch validation; current-only admission; predecessor cleanup and cumulative limits across successor identities; independent reviews and exact release enrollment.

rollback: Disable paid execution and revoke temporary authority; retain all old and new records and accounting. Restore last qualified Preview alias. Preserve legacy readback support even if compact admission is disabled.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Incomplete, refused or malformed output remains rejected; no fake artifact.
negativePaths.stale-state: Old policies, grants and release fingerprints cannot authorize new execution.
negativePaths.concurrency: Serial cumulative admission and existing CAS; predecessor must be closed and clean.
negativePaths.cancellation: Revocation and emergency stop remain authoritative; no retry after failure.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Data-only source copy and worker cleanup remain bounded; partial output is not success.
negativePaths.api-outage: No automatic paid retry; preserve sanitized diagnostic and usage uncertainty.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: No bypass of owner, task, workspace, source, release or review controls.
negativePaths.spending-limit: Existing aggregate authorization and token/call/time caps preserved across distinct successors.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Only actual completed stages are reported; later stages cannot conceal failure.

defects.rootCause: Directly observed incomplete/max_output_tokens at 4000 output; exact partial content not retained. Schema permits repeated narratives; not proof of specific model verbosity.
defects.detectionGap: Previous fixtures did not stress response output budget; schema-valid Chief criteria contained clipped words.
defects.regression: Versioned compact schema/instructions, all five deterministic stages, strict incomplete-output rejection, immutable legacy request hash and cumulative successor authority tests.
defects.historicalPrevention: No retroactive output reconstruction, receipt rewrite, invoice reconciliation or consumed authorization reuse.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend existing implementation profile, controller and journal only; no new orchestration, credential, ledger or executor.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No added package, provider, sandbox, browser service or infrastructure spending.
proactiveReview.threats: Contract drift invalidating history; successor resets; model truncation; false success or acceptance.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Any incomplete or malformed response fails closed with diagnostic and observed usage; no automatic provider retries.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Legacy policy fresh-admission denial, stale binding, malformed/incomplete responses, excessive arrays/text, missing criteria, forged source/acceptance, exhausted aggregate attempts/exposure and unclean predecessor.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Work QA and Auditor inspect actual failure, exact changes, historical readback and security controls before release.
proactiveReview.recovery: Close failed attempt, preserve evidence and uncertainty, revoke all authority; fresh exact reviewed release/config/task only.
proactiveReview.readiness: Focused offline checks, STRICT/Redis/CI/CodeQL/Jekyll/Browser and exact runtime/config readback before any further authorized paid attempt.
